اعتطفتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَطَفْتُمْ (iʕtaṭaftum) /iʕ.ta.tˤaf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اُعْتُطِفْتُمْ (uʕtuṭiftum) /uʕ.tu.tˤif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
